name: Donagh Gordon
biography: Since 2010 Donagh has been acting in various projects both on TV and in film. Originally from Dublin, Ireland, he worked in London and Paris in the banking sector for many years. He came to Mexico for a change of life and left behind the city offices for film and TV studios. Although not so young, he had the strength to renounce the comforts of life to start again from scratch. He has worked in films such as Colombiana (2011) , Cesar Chavez (2014), Mentada de Padre (2019), My Boyfriend's Meds (2020) and Bardo: False Chronicle of a Handful of Truths (2022). He also has appeared in TV series such as El Señor de los Cielos (2013), Enemigo Íntimo (2018), Los miserables (2014), Lady of Steel (2014), La piloto 2 (2017), Ana (2020), and High Heat (2022). He has also appeared in commercials both in Mexico and abroad.
